name: Summon Plant

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Summon a Fungus, Tree, or Vine spirit into a visible empty space. It acts just after you on your Initiative, follows free verbal commands, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. It disappears at 0 HP or spell end. Slot level scales the source Plant Spirit stat block; you control its actions and movement.
